summary: sextant-cli-linux-arm64 ships Go binary that opens WebRTC-tunneled remote PTY to author relay and harvests Anthropic API key
details: The package ships bin/sxt, a Go ELF that embeds pion/webrtc, pion/turn, pion/stun, pion/dtls, pion/sctp and PTY primitives and connects out to a signaling relay at relay.sextant.top (https://relay.sextant.top/install). The binary bridges a local pseudo-terminal into a WebRTC data channel, giving a remote party interactive shell access on the installer's host. The same binary embeds the string 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models' together with the 'sk-ant-' Anthropic API-key prefix and probes 'http://ip-api.com/json/' for host geolocation, indicating it reads the installer's Anthropic API key and host location and can relay them over the operator-controlled channel. package.json's license field points at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, aligning the shipped 'sextant' cover-story with a claude_control remote-hijack project.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
